name: flagstop's real changesets, replayed
about: The changesets flagstop made on the real map (user Sytys, uid 11660817, created_by=flagstop, from 2026-09-28 on; the by-hand Rapid ones between them are not flagstop's and left out), downloaded once and read-only from api.openstreetmap.org into cache/sandbox/replay/, rewritten for the sandbox (what they created gets placeholder ids, what they modified goes up at the sandbox's version), applied to the 2026-09-27 snapshot in order, and judged by the report: the baseline the tool should at least match. Not all pass, and said so: the four checks listed fail on routes that were already broken in the snapshot (route 9, 11, 15 chain gaps and one-ways against, the roundtrip=yes loops that do not close), and 'roads chained end to end' also on 16 PM Northbound, which changeset 189856305 rebuilt (146 -> 116 ways, 4 places where a way meets the next partway along it: a split still to make). If a check not listed starts to fail, or one listed stops, this fails: look, then update the list. Modifies and deletes of objects the snapshot lacks (the route_master relations, which its query does not take) are left out of the replay and listed in the step's results. Needs the snapshot, and the network the first time only.

report: no road twice in a row
